name: Post-Employment Non-Compete Restriction
pattern: shall not (join|work with|be employed by).*competitor.*(after termination|after leaving|for a period of)
reason: Agreements restraining an individual from exercising a lawful profession, trade, or business after leaving employment are void ab initio under Indian law.
legalSource: Indian Contract Act, 1872 - Section 27 (Agreement in restraint of trade, void; Percept D'Mark v. Zaheer Khan, 2006 SC)
caveat: Non-compete during active term of employment is valid; post-employment restraint is void under Indian law.

name: Disproportionate Service Bond Penalty
reason: Employment bonds that demand exorbitant liquidated damages far exceeding actual demonstrable training expenditure are treated as unconstitutional bonded labor / illegal penalties.
legalSource: Indian Contract Act, 1872 - Section 74 & Article 23 of the Constitution of India
caveat: Employers can only recover actual, documented training expenses incurred on the employee, amortized by service.
